title: Two-member rigid frame with an inclined member, joint load and distributed load

source.work: McGuire, W., Gallagher, R. H., Ziemian, R. D., Matrix Structural Analysis
source.notes: input data and targets read on the cited pages; nothing of the source is reproduced

analysis: Plane (x-y) problem of the source modelled in 3D with the global Y axis vertical, so that the source's x, y and theta_z are the model's X, Y and rz. In-plane bending is about local z for every member (default orientation), hence the source's I is the section's Iz. a (0, 0), b (sqrt 55, 3), c (sqrt 55 + 8, 3) m: ab is 8 m long with a 3 m rise (printed run 7.416 m), bc horizontal, 8 m. Both members A = 6000 mm^2, I = 200e6 mm^4; E = 200,000 MPa. a and c fixed. Loads: the source's components of the 50 kN joint load at b, 18.75 kN (+x) and -46.35 kN (y); 4 kN/m downward on bc. First order, flexural and axial deformation. Section properties the source does not give because they do not enter its plane model (Iy, J; A where stated) are placeholders that do not influence the targets.

quarantine.diagnosis: 7 of 9 targets missed, by 0.1 % to 0.5 % (tolerances 5e-5 to 9e-4). Engine: u_b = 0.99500 mm, v_b = -4.98158 mm, theta_b = -5.3423e-4 rad; reactions 130.500 kN, 55.676 kN, 13374.6 kN mm, -149.250 kN, 22.674 kN, -45356.6 kN mm. Printed: 0.9982 (0.09982 in the solution line, a misprint - 0.9982 is used in the reaction product), -4.996, -0.000534; 131.0, 55.4, 13.43e3, -149.7, 22.7, -45.41e3. Cause: rounding in the source's hand calculation - its stiffness coefficients are carried with three or four significant figures and later results are computed from rounded earlier ones, so the last printed digit of its results is not reliable, while the policy counts every printed digit as significant. Evidence: the printed displacements are the exact solution of the source's printed 3 x 3 matrix (1.394, 0.259, 7.031; 0.114, 1.368; 2e5), but its coefficient 0.114 stands for (EA/L) sin^2 + (12EI/L^3) cos^2 + 12EI/L^3 = 0.10950 + 0.00469 = 0.11419; the source rounds 0.1095 to 0.109 and the sum 0.11369 to 0.114, and v_b is sensitive to this coefficient. The printed vertical reactions leave a residual of 0.25 kN (55.4 + 22.7 - 46.35 - 32). The engine's results for this model are confirmed by the other tiers that apply (tier C: OpenSeesPy and PyNite agree with the engine; tier D: equilibrium and the other invariants pass); the difference is between the source's printed digits and the exact solution of the stated problem.
